scientific_integrity: The proof establishes an all-parameter result, while exhaustive finite computations are supporting evidence and not mistaken for an infinite proof. No external independent audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only synchronization basins on K_m square K_n, m,n>=2, are counted; other recurrent dynamics unclassified. General irrotational synchronization and general Widom-Rowlinson graph-homomorphism identities are established prior results. Exact rook specialization and asymptotic are checked internally but not independently audited; unindexed earlier derivations remain possible.
title: Exact synchronization counts and exponential rarity for three-color cyclic automata on rook graphs
